about: The public shape of the Pulse vault (pulse@newsroom, for the SGit newsroom), exported by admin/build/export_pulse.py. Ladders, dates, attention counts and the short quotes Pulse recorded, each with the capture it comes from; no capture is copied and no key is kept here.

head.message: pulse@newsroom: a rung is 'not reached' only when an open capture shows it; GitHub search API refused (403, session proxy) in every pass so far, so rung 2 and the PR searches are 'not checked', with the blocked sources listed

pulse_says: Every tracked CVE: its evidence of exploitation (the rungs reached, with dates) and the attention it gets (counts), side by side. They are never combined: there is no score, no rank and no advice. Rows are in CVE order. Each row points to its ladder and attention files, which point to the captures.

evidence.quote: Now the patches have been released, the Amazon Threat Intelligence team has publically confirmed they observed a PHP2Shell exploitation attempt dating October 17. reported_not_established.by: ČVUT (Czech Technical University), quoted by Lupa.cz
reported_not_established.quote: ČVUT v současnosti řeší kybernetický útok na svou IT infrastrukturu. Jedná se o součást celosvětových pokusů zasáhnout weby s technologií PHP. Aktivní útok se podařilo zastavit
reported_not_established.what_it_is: A named organisation describing an attack, part of worldwide attempts against PHP sites, that was stopped: an attempt, not a stated compromise through the flaw. Lupa.cz adds it is not yet clear the outage relates to PHP2Shell. Read from the watch's contradiction compromise-cvut, open.

reported_not_established.quote: to respond to a vulnerability found in external software (as summarised in the watch; DMM would not confirm a link to PHP)
reported_not_established.what_it_is: A named company's emergency maintenance, no stated link to PHP. Read from the watch's contradiction compromise-dmm, open.

reported_not_established.by: GMO Internet Group, via J-CAST / Yahoo! News Japan
reported_not_established.quote: Unauthorised programs found on 20 October on some servers (as summarised in the watch); the article does not name PHP or php2shell
reported_not_established.what_it_is: A confirmed compromise of named systems with no stated cause. Coincidence in time is not attribution. Read from the watch's contradiction compromise-gmo-fx-vps, open.

reported_not_established.quote: PHPの脆弱性を標的としたサイバー攻撃 (first statement) / 我々のサービス自体の脆弱性 (correction)
reported_not_established.what_it_is: A first attribution to the PHP flaw, corrected by the company the same day: its own service's flaw was exploited. Read from the watch's contradiction compromise-valtec, resolved.
